title_sq: APARTAMENT 2+1 PER SHITJE NE RRUGEN E KOSOVARVE 230,000 €
description_sq:
LEDA (SUN122823)
Prona ndodhet ne Rrugen e Kosovarve pas Hotel Dinasty. Pozicionohet ne katin e trete te nje objekti te ndertuar ne vitin 2003 me ashensor. Pallati eshte perfitues nga projekti i bashkise per tu bere fasada me sistem kapot dhe aktualisht eshte mbledhur shuma 50% nga banoret dhe 50% do te jete financim i Bashkise Tirane.
Organizohet ne koridor qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, ambient ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet, nje lavanteri (mund te behet tualet i dyte) dhe nje ballkon. Prona ka nevoje per tu riinvestuar ku bashkangjitur do te keni planimetrine dhe per cdo info na kontaktoni tu dergojme te dhenat e tjera.
Zona eshte nga me atraktivet pasi ka akses te lehte me institucinet, sherbimet, parkun e liqenit etj.
Per nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE ON KOSOVARI STREET €230,000
description_en: LEDA (SUN122823) The property is located on Rugen e Kosovarve, behind Hotel Dinasty. It is located on the third floor of a building built in 2003 with an elevator. The palace is a beneficiary of the municipality's project to make facades with a capot system and currently 50% of the amount has been collected from the residents and 50% will be financed by the Municipality of Tirana. It is organized in a corridor that distributes the premises, a living room together with a kitchen, two bedrooms, a toilet, a laundry room (a second toilet can be made) and a balcony. The property needs to be reinvested, where you will find attached the plan and for any information, contact us to send the other data. The area is one of the most attractive as it has easy access to institutions, services, the lake park, etc. For a visit to the property, contact us.
